description: This Java enum defines different streaming types used in the Eclipse Ditto project, such as events, messages, and live commands/events, along with methods to determine the streaming type based on topics or signals.

classes.name: StreamingType
classes.description: An enumeration representing various streaming types such as EVENTS, MESSAGES, LIVE_COMMANDS, and LIVE_EVENTS, with methods to retrieve associated pub/sub topics, determine if a signal is live, and infer streaming type from signals.

methods.name: getDistributedPubSubTopic
methods.description: Returns the pub/sub topic string associated with the streaming type.

methods.name: fromTopic
methods.description: Creates a StreamingType instance from a given pub/sub topic string.

methods.name: isLiveSignal
methods.description: Checks if a given signal belongs to the live channel.

methods.name: fromSignal
methods.description: Infers the streaming type from a given signal.
